about: Who keeps each service (#9895). A town draws one person per service from its list by its stable identity. A portrait is the keeper's bust in the dialogue: a rig-c parts rig the Engine poses live in the dialogue frame's window (#10027, made with the parts-rig route in art/people/README.md), its resting clip and the clip it plays while a new line is said, its texel (rig units a texel) and frame [x, y, side]: the square of the rig's plane the window shows, in rig units, whole texels from its origin. A person without one shows no portrait. A figure is the keeper standing at their door in the town view: a rig-c parts rig the Engine poses at runtime, its looping clip, metres per rig unit and texel (rig units per texel); the kit piece's keeper spot is where they stand.
